definitions.explanation: An article or item that has been manufactured.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}の{製品|せいひん}は{品質|ひんしつ}が{良|い}い。
examples.english: This company's products are of good quality.

examples.japanese: {新製品|しんせいひん}を{発売|はつばい}した。

notes: Emphasizes manufactured items. Compare with {商品|しょうひん} (goods for sale) which focuses on the commercial aspect.
